As Laurie filled out his receipt, he pulled out his gun and struck the owner, Ms. Gallagher, on the head. The gun discharged hitting the ceiling, but authorities believe the man thought he killed her, so he kidnapped Laurie, the only other person in the store. The pigs were born at the sanctuary when one of two neglected pot-bellied pigs seized by the SPCA unexpectedly gave birth to a litter of five after being taken in.
